sloka: सुग्रीवो राघवः च एव वयस्यत्वम् उपागतौ ।ततः सुप्रीत मनसौ तौ उभौ हरि राघवौ ॥४-५-१६॥
transliteration: sugrīvo rāghavaḥ ca eva vayasyatvam upāgatau ।tataḥ suprīta manasau tau ubhau hari rāghavau ॥4-5-16॥

translations.english: They both circumambulated the blazing fire and solemnized their friendship.
